Unlock and open the chamber door, first placing the support tray under the sample
recovery: If any temperature/vacuum status is unknown, keep the chamber closed and return it to the shutdown service; forced opening is prohibited

operations.title: Disconnect leads, release pressure, and retrieve the sample
actions: Disconnect and coil the leads, then raise the upper-contact proxy
Support the sample as you retrieve it into its numbered carrier; remove the lower support and return it to the rack, then close the empty chamber
recovery: If the conditions are not met, stop this step and retain the original object/invalid event; do not rewrite equipment ground truth yourself

operations.title: Calculate power and efficiency and label the comparison basis
actions: Calculate P=I×V with appropriate units; calculate η=P/(P+Qc) only when evidence establishes Qc in W
Extract the sampled maximum P/η for each condition; calculate P/area only when the area is known; save calculation references and limitations
recovery: If the conditions are not met, stop this step and retain the original object/invalid event; do not rewrite equipment ground truth yourself

operations.title: Archive samples/remaining material/data
actions: Place intact unmeasured, measured, probe-contacted, damaged, and unknown items in separate compartments
Seal remaining powder, remaining legs, and offcuts; reconcile parent-child quantities and run files, then close the box lids
recovery: If quantities or labels do not match, retain missing fields and isolation; do not duplicate samples to balance the ledger

operations.title: Physically reset the tools and work surface
actions: Return empty carriers, die sleeves, punches, positioning parts, and simulated scoops to their designated slots
Seal powder/metal/quartz-tube proxy waste in boxes for handoff; wipe permitted surfaces and put away the wipes; close empty equipment doors
recovery: Do not blow away unknown residue, mix waste, or improvise solvents; keep it enclosed for handoff
